storyTemplate.title: Sandbox School Story
storyTemplate.description: A school start with adult characters: arrive for the first day at a specialized academy and find your assigned room.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text:
Alderbridge Academy rises behind iron gates, old brick walls, and banners snapping in the morning wind.

Your acceptance packet lists a room number, a schedule, and a warning that late arrivals must report in person. Students and trainees cross the courtyard in clusters, already sorting themselves into friends and rivals.

The first bell is close.
